column1: # OTA-capable partition table for 16MB flash (Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 Plus on the
# EE02 board). Two app slots so the config portal's firmware update writes
# the new image to the inactive slot and only switches over on success.
# The 1600x1200 layout carries its own fonts and icons (about 750 KB)
# slots are larger than the 8MB table's.
